name: Hiworld (5A A5): any car (raw messages)
description: Hiworld box (5A A5 LEN CMD data CS, CS = LEN + CMD + data - 1, 38400 bit/s), any car: no decoding, the CAN tab shows the raw messages. The head unit acknowledges every message of the box (FF <cmd>), as Hiworld's app does. Without a car profile the box gets no car type: it repeats its messages once a second and sends no steering wheel key. Also the description of this box type for the car profiles that name it ("box": "hiworld").
